veranderings.rede: In the present tense a learner can read this as maize being imported from America today; 'oorspronklik' makes the intended meaning (where the crop came from) clear without adding a fact.

vlae.teks: het deur handel by Delagoabaai hier beland
vlae.rede: 'hier' has no stated referent (Southern Africa, KwaZulu-Natal, the Zulu area?); a more exact place would read better, but choosing one means guessing the intended scope, so it is flagged rather than changed.
